notes: MLS Assist v1.37 — The schedule read now captures the PROVIDER (doctor) for each appointment, plus the distinct list of providers on the day, by reading athenaOne’s schedule-grid provider column / provider grouping (read-only; diagnostics contain no patient PHI). This powers the new “Whose patients?” doctor picker in MLS, so you can pull ONLY one doctor’s patients. If a schedule shows no per-doctor data, MLS safely pulls all and tells you. Download and reload at chrome://extensions to update.
